name: dist_m
why: Perpendicular distance GPS point -> arc segment. Right arc is usually the closest.

name: dist_rank
why: Rank of this candidate by distance within the observation (0 = nearest).

name: dist_minus_min
why: dist minus the nearest candidate's dist: relative closeness, comparable across noisy/clean trips.

name: dist_ratio
why: dist / (min dist + 1): scale-free closeness.

name: n_cands
why: Number of candidates for this observation (junction / dense-network indicator).

name: heading_cos
why: cos(GPS heading - arc bearing): +1 same direction, -1 reverse twin. Separates the two directed arcs of a two-way road.

name: heading_sin_abs
why: |sin(heading diff)|: how perpendicular the motion is to the arc (cross streets at junctions).

name: speed_mps
why: Speed from the +-2 point window; lets the model learn heading is unreliable when slow.

name: arc_len_m
why: Arc length: short arcs near junctions behave differently from long road segments.

name: proj_frac
why: Where along the arc the point projects (0 start .. 1 end).

name: dist_to_end_m
why: Metres from the projection to the arc's downstream end (about to turn / leave the arc).

name: has_twin
why: Reverse arc exists (about 92% of arcs): direction matters for these.

name: win2_mean_dist
why: Mean distance of points i-2..i+2 to this arc: temporal consistency, damps single-point noise.

name: win5_mean_dist
why: Same over i-5..i+5: the true arc stays close for the whole window, wrong arcs drift away.

name: win5_rel
why: win5_mean_dist minus the best candidate's win5_mean_dist for this observation (relative window fit).

name: win5_heading_cos
why: Mean heading agreement with this arc over the window: more robust than a single noisy heading.

name: from_deg
why: Degree of the arc's start node (intersection complexity).

name: to_deg
why: Degree of the arc's end node (intersection complexity).

name: dt_prev
why: Seconds since previous fix (sampling irregularity).

name: dt_next
why: Seconds to next fix.

name: gap_flag
why: 1 if a neighbouring step is a gap (> 10 s): window/heading features are weaker there.

name: accel
why: Acceleration (m/s^2) from the speed series: stops/starts happen at junctions.

name: dist_z
why: dist / per-trip GPS-noise estimate (median nearest-arc distance, label-free): noise-normalised distance.
